history.text: Swahili traders linked the coast to the Indian Ocean gold trade.
Vasco da Gama reached the coast; Portugal established trading posts.
FRELIMO fought a war of independence against Portugal.
Civil war between FRELIMO and RENAMO ended with the Rome accord.

worthSeeing.title: Island of Mozambique:
worthSeeing.text: The former colonial capital, a UNESCO World Heritage site.

worthSeeing.title: Bazaruto Archipelago:
worthSeeing.text: Dunes, reefs and one of the last dugong populations in the region.

worthSeeing.title: Gorongosa National Park:
worthSeeing.text: A Rift Valley park whose wildlife has been restored since the war.
